press_references.value: PreFlight Slicer Brings Added Part Strength Feature, And Many More

product_launches.description: Open-source 3D printing software preFlight Slicer is available as a slicer with new capabilities such as mixed support types, Nip & Tuck seams, image embossing, smart bridging, side-view previews, and an Interlocking Perimeters feature for stronger parts, supported by the Athena perimeter generator and embedded Python runtime.

press_references.value: Preflight Clearance Introduces Pre-Release System to Detect Content Risk Before Distribution

product_launches.description: Preflight Clearance launched its Pre-Release Exposure Evaluation System, a deterministic diagnostic engine that evaluates digital content for structural risk conditions before distribution.

overview_description.description: PreFlight automates software testing in the browser. There's no need for any technical knowledge. You simply record your tests, as if manually testing, then you can repeat those tests automatically, on-demand or on-a-schedule.
